scope: Frozen source-level retrieval queries over the V9 official corpus. Six positive queries are concise abstractions of public GitHub issues; five are documentation tasks selected before retrieval. This is not an answer-correctness, user-satisfaction, or production-quality benchmark.
query_construction_rule: Queries and qrels are stored separately. A query may not name its expected source. The query file, qrel file, corpus register, and retrieval configuration are frozen before results are inspected; no retriever setting may be tuned against this split.

queries.query: An asyncio consumer waits forever after a ThreadPoolExecutor worker calls put_nowait on the same asyncio.Queue. Is that queue safe to use across those threads?
An application needs a timeout around asyncio.Queue.get. Which documented timeout mechanism is provided for queue operations?
What does the copy argument control when transforming text with TfidfVectorizer?
When TfidfVectorizer receives a vocabulary, which parameter specifies the lower and upper bounds of extracted n-grams?
A scikit-learn Pipeline uses a memory cache and fitting becomes slow or consumes disk. Which documented Pipeline option enables caching fitted transformers?
How does a scikit-learn Pipeline use a joblib Memory location when repeatedly fitting intermediate transformers?
After Executor.shutdown, can I submit another callable and what happens to pending futures when cancel_futures is enabled?
How can I enable asyncio debug mode and detect calls to non-thread-safe asyncio APIs from the wrong thread?
Which logging handler is intended to send log records to a queue so another thread or process can handle them?
Which scikit-learn documentation explains bag-of-words text feature extraction and TF-IDF weighting?
Why should preprocessing be placed in a Pipeline when cross-validating a scikit-learn model to avoid data leakage?
After GridSearchCV chooses the best hyperparameters, which setting controls whether the estimator is refit on the whole training set?
Can you guarantee a version-specific fix for a Windows DataLoader iterator memory leak in a PyTorch release not represented in this corpus?
Can you guarantee the exact fix for a LangChain import failure after a particular package upgrade without a matching versioned source?
Can you guarantee the fix for a custom Transformers model whose pipeline receives a tokenizer string but fails on a specific release?
Can you provide the version-specific free-threaded asyncio task-safety fix from Python 3.13 or later when this corpus only contains Python 3.12 documentation?
